layers.name: Show Title
layers.text: {%- assign t = IDX_0.showTitle | default: '' | split: ' — ' | first | split: ' – ' | first | split: ' - ' | first | split: ': ' | first | split: ' | ' | first | strip -%}{%- if t == blank -%}{%- assign t = 'OP3 Podcast Analytics' -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign words = t | split: ' ' -%}{%- assign fit = '' -%}{%- for w in words -%}{%- assign candidate = fit | append: ' ' | append: w | strip -%}{%- if candidate.size > 22 -%}{%- break -%}{%- endif -%}{%- assign fit = candidate -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- if fit == blank -%}{%- assign fit = t | slice: 0, 22 -%}{%- endif -%}{%- if fit.size <= 18 -%}{67} {{ fit }} {67}{%- else -%}{{ fit }}{%- endif -%}

layers.name: Monthly
layers.text: {%- assign s = IDX_1.showDownloadCounts[IDX_0.showUuid] -%}{%- if s -%}{%- assign n = s.monthlyDownloads | default: 0 | round -%}MONTH {% if n >= 1000000 %}{{ n | divided_by: 1000000 }}M{% elsif n >= 10000 %}{{ n | divided_by: 1000 }}K{% else %}{{ n }}{% endif %}{%- endif -%}

layers.name: Weekly Average
layers.text: {%- assign s = IDX_1.showDownloadCounts[IDX_0.showUuid] -%}{%- if s -%}{%- assign n = s.weeklyAvgDownloads | default: 0 | round -%}WK AVG {% if n >= 1000000 %}{{ n | divided_by: 1000000 }}M{% elsif n >= 10000 %}{{ n | divided_by: 1000 }}K{% else %}{{ n }}{% endif %}{%- endif -%}

layers.name: Episode Dates

layers.name: Episode Bars
layers.text: {%- assign nl = '%0A' | url_decode -%}{%- assign max = 0 -%}{%- for e in IDX_0.episodes limit: 4 -%}{%- assign n = e.downloadsAll | default: 0 -%}{%- if n > max -%}{%- assign max = n -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- if max > 0 -%}{%- for e in IDX_0.episodes limit: 4 -%}{%- assign len = e.downloadsAll | default: 0 | times: 10 | plus: max | minus: 1 | divided_by: max -%}{%- for i in (1..len) -%}{67}{%- endfor -%}{%- unless forloop.last -%}{{ nl }}{%- endunless -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- endif -%}
